assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's three curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the canonical V1 Wonderlands×Showtime main-story causal synthesis (Japanese wonder_01_00-wonder_01_20 at the EVENT_0213 lock), and the canonical Generation 2 Tsukasa monograph and reconstruction model through EVENT_0222 at the PJSK_SOURCE_20261030T035133Z_EVENT_0222 lock, located by story, event, card, area and My SEKAI locators. Speech is the original-Japanese textual register; no performed voice or audiovisual analysis is admitted. The project reconstruction method and the WxS textual-register remediation audit (Tsukasa scene tests T1-T6) were read only as method context and calibration; the uncurated evidence index, event readings, ledgers and Generation 1 files are not curated on this subject and no claim rests on them. The model's R4 readiness label is project-local and was not adopted. No primary source was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Tsukasa from the main story through EVENT_0222. Default state: after the EVENT_0208 cohosted production and its card (card 1410), with EVENT_0178's recipient relation and the EVENT_0113 and EVENT_0136 role and body methods retained; EVENT_0217 adds an offered Wonder! audition only and EVENT_0218 an ordinary older-brother preference. Earlier states are used only at the milestones the items locate (main-story formation and repair; EVENT_0113, 0136, 0160, 0178, 0208); states between them rest on ledger snapshots that are not curated here. My SEKAI and some area encounters have no securely inferred date. The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: he holds the recovered childhood anger from EVENT_0208 on, while Saki and the troupe do not receive it.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states aims, pressures, methods, knowledge and open questions; five invariants framed as tensions, not rules; a conditional table (familiar company, small unfamiliar role, physical obstacle, role requiring alien feeling, companions intervene, family after withdrawal); and decision heuristics. The monograph's thesis ties the star ideal to recipients while pride and urgency can crowd out listening, and the synthesis locates the main-story mechanism (care present before its purpose is recovered in wonder_01_14). It predicts his overreach: immersion that removes support before he sees the cost (EVENT_0208), effort overriding method, and refusal to promise not to repeat it (card 1410). Not A: the package is compact for a long live-service corpus, and the threshold at which he would refuse retrieval again is untested. Not C: the evidence says what changes his response (the kind of problem, who intervenes, what each person knows) and where that stops; the deciding motive in the immersion conflict is stated (he credits the method with his growth), so the remaining uncertainty is about threshold and timing.

Milestones are located with mechanisms: main-story formation, collapse and repair; EVENT_0113 sparse-role research; EVENT_0136 bodily limits and expert help; EVENT_0160 listener-chosen ending; EVENT_0178 a world without recipients; EVENT_0208 recovered memory and immersion; EVENT_0217-0218. Not B: the curated items give milestones rather than a continuous state sequence, and they defer earlier scenarios to ledger states and a Generation 1 file not curated here. Not D: each milestone carries a separately evidenced change with its cause.

The model's register table gives nine located D0 observations, each with state, recipient and pressure, observed Japanese wording, conditional use and a competing possibility: formal 「お約束いたします」 beside theatrical self-announcement, an early deferential 「僕」 against later 「オレ」, acknowledgment and paraphrase to an instructor, plain register to an honorifically addressed peer, 「す、すまない」 at a familiar correction, the courteous frame around 「絶対にオレに、話しかけないでくれ」, 「もうしないとは……悪いが、言えない」, warm family repair, and the insect fright. A mode guard excludes acted-role speech (Benkei 「貴様」, Breath 「俺」). Not A: no frequency rule, and the D0 rows extend only to D1-D2 matched scenes. Not C: register is tied to recipient, state and aim with stated alternatives.

Ordinary conduct is sampled: boasting, organizing, teasing and helping in familiar company; family care (curry and dessert for Saki); low-stakes My SEKAI encounters (moving landing mats, misreading Mizuki's question and correcting himself); the insect fright with Len; delight on the Broadway trip; the older-brother preference. Not B: the sample is a handful of scenes and does not establish routine or frequency. Not D: the contrasts are given conditions and competing possibilities.

Directed evidence exists: the synthesis distinguishes the main-story Tsukasa-Emu, Tsukasa-Nene and Tsukasa-Rui relationships, each with its own repair; the monograph and model condition Saki (loved, excluded from information, repaired with concrete care, not told the anger), the troupe's EVENT_0208 interventions with each member's contribution, Len, the instructors whose authority is limited to a craft problem, Asahi and Toya. Not B: at the default state Emu, Nene and Rui are conditioned largely as a group beyond their EVENT_0208 roles, so the evidence does not say how his response differs among them in a new conflict. Not D: the Saki and instructor conditions are explained by knowledge and authority differences.

EVENT_0208 gives located interior material, separated by source: the child's remembered complaint, the adult's private recognition and self-judgment, parenthesized thought against speech, and a knowledge-boundary table in the synthesis (the childhood motive recovered privately in wonder_01_14). Not B: outside the main-story recovery and EVENT_0208, interior access is thin, and the items warn against taking the child's interpretation of his parents or the adult's self-description as established. Not D: the private states are analysed, not merely reported.

Conflict is conditioned by stakes and relation: the main-story attack on Nene's vulnerability after a distributed technical failure, Rui's overreaching accusation, apology and repair; a familiar correction met by a quick apology and resumed delight (card 1470); companions' interruption resisted as interference, then received, with gratitude and continuing disagreement (EVENT_0208, card 1410); a mistaken premise corrected without a wounded-pride crisis (My SEKAI); Len's misreading corrected. Not A: the point of future receptivity to intervention is untested. Not C: each conflict type has a stated response family and its limit.

Ethically relevant conduct is located and evaluated by the items: the main-story treatment of Nene, the coercive means of the repair (chasing Nene, transporting Rui) that the items refuse to read as consent, the apology that is not retrospective permission, the EVENT_0160 respect for an owner's chosen ending, and the refusal to promise safe practice. Not C: the items evaluate his conduct but do not reconstruct how he weighs competing duties, and ETHICS is not among the dimensions the discovery row claims. Not E: the conduct is located across the main story and several events.

Comic embarrassment, grandiose self-announcement, boasting and teasing in familiar company, and delight are noted; the model warns against making him only loud comedy. Not C: no account of what his humour does or when play stops is given. Not E: the comic register recurs in the conditional table, the register rows and the failure modes.

The package covers the main story and selected events through EVENT_0222 at a fixed source lock with exact locators, and a register remediation audit (method context) records fits and one insufficiency. Not B: the curated material is about 36 KB for a long live-service corpus, earlier states between milestones rest on uncurated ledgers, primary-source inspection is attributed provenance, and audiovisual performance is excluded. Not D: the dedicated monograph and model are current Generation 2 analyses at a stated boundary.

Affirmative limits are located: he explicitly refuses to promise not to reuse the immersion method (card 1410); the troupe's retrieval commitment is untested; the audition is offered, not won; Asahi's absence is unexplained; the parents' motives are not established by the child's interpretation; Saki and the troupe do not receive the anger; acted-role speech is excluded; the insect episode is ordinary fear, not relapse; a successful performance does not prove its preparation safe; forced transport in the repair is not consent. Not A: some limits rest on open future events rather than evidence of incapacity. Not C: these are evidenced findings, not silence.

A default simulation state is defined, knowledge is tracked separately from personality change (the synthesis's knowledge table), events and cards are located, future items are marked as future (the audition, the family dinner), and My SEKAI encounters are flagged as undated. Not A: states between milestones are deferred to uncurated ledgers. Not C: the declared default state and milestones are explicit.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese lines only, never presented as quotation; select state, recipient, information and aim before wording.
Recipients and modes from the register table; 「僕」 and 「オレ」 both available, chosen by addressee, not by a developmental rule.
Exclude acted-role speech and remembered childhood speech from his present-day voice; no performed voice, loudness or timing.
scenario_readiness.note: The register rows constrain short written-Japanese lines for the sampled recipients and states. Not READY: no frequency rule and no performed voice. Not NOT_READY: each row ties wording to recipient, state and aim with a competing possibility.

conditions: Ask which audience, role and person he believes he must reach; separate research, imagined scene, childhood memory and staged fiction.
Predict both disciplined method and the risk that urgency displaces it; never infer that a successful result proves the preparation safe.
Give his response to a companion's intervention as initial resistance, possible reception and retained disagreement, not a guaranteed safeguard.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The post-EVENT_0208 default state through EVENT_0222, with the recovered childhood anger known only to him and the Wonder! audition unresolved; or a located earlier milestone with its own knowledge state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Wonderlands×Showtime companions (Emu, Nene, Rui), Saki, a craft instructor or director whose authority covers one problem, Wonderland Len, or a low-stakes cross-unit acquaintance of the sampled kind; transfer to an unsampled relationship is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
setting_constraints: A new acting, production or stage-craft problem, or a family interaction, matched in knowledge and stakes to the located cases (D1-D2).
No clinical interpretation, permanent career outcome, audition result, Asahi history or universal safety prediction (D3-D4).
Textual Japanese register only; no performed voice.

scenario_readiness.note: A new matched acting problem or family interaction is supported at moderate confidence. Not READY: the threshold for renewed immersion or refusal of retrieval is untested and current troupe members are conditioned largely as a group. Not NOT_READY: the conditional table and decision heuristics cover the problem types the events sample.

conditions: Settings sampled: familiar troupe company, family time with Saki, low-stakes cross-unit My SEKAI contact, Wonderland Len, travel with the quartet.
Helpful initiative and confident misreading are both plausible; small corrections are taken without a wounded-pride crisis.
scenario_readiness.note: Low-stakes encounters are sampled across several recipients. Not READY: a handful of scenes, without routine or frequency. Not NOT_READY: helpfulness, confident overinterpretation and quick correction are each located.

The items locate ethically relevant conduct and evaluate it (the main-story treatment of Nene, coercive repair means, the refusal to promise safe practice) but do not reconstruct how he weighs competing obligations.
None of the curated items addresses romantic relationships.

conditions: Stage and acting work with the troupe or a bounded instructor or director, at the default or a located state.
Supported: researching a small role, seeking tailored technique and recovery, responding to a particular listener, accepting craft-limited instruction, overreaching under urgency or immersion.
Not supported: the Wonder! audition outcome, professional career attainment, conduct in an unsampled production hierarchy.
scenario_readiness.note: Acting and stage craft are his best-sampled domain. Not READY: the audition, future safeguards and shared careers are open. Not NOT_READY: role research, bodily revision, expert instruction, listener-responsive performance and immersion risk are located across events.

known_limits.statement: After EVENT_0208 he thanks and apologizes to the troupe but explicitly refuses to promise not to use the immersion method again; their retrieval commitment is untested.
The recovered childhood anger is known only to him; Saki and the troupe do not receive it, and the child's reading of his parents is not an established parental intention.
The Wonder! audition is offered, not won; Asahi's absence and unanswered messages remain unexplained; the family dinner after card 1410 is future within the scene.
Acted-role lines (EVENT_0131 Benkei, EVENT_0185 Breath) are not his voice, and My SEKAI encounters have no securely inferred event date.
The main-story repair used chasing and transport; his apology renews the relationship but is not retrospective consent, and success in one production does not prove its methods safe.
States between the located milestones rest on ledger snapshots and a Generation 1 file that are not curated on this subject.
At the default state the curated items do not differentiate how he responds to Emu, Nene and Rui individually beyond their EVENT_0208 roles.
Speech evidence is original-Japanese text; performed voice, timing and loudness are not analysed.
